description: Sets up a measurement subdomain for Metrunio analytics: a CNAME that routes measurement traffic, a TXT record proving you control the domain, and a CNAME that lets Google issue the TLS certificate for the subdomain.
variableDescription: dnstarget: the Metrunio host label your subdomain points to; the template appends .metrunio.com. token: a one-time random value that proves you control the domain. acme: the Google Certificate Manager authorization label; the template appends .authorize.certificatemanager.goog.
